main_text.p: de asellis iudicium, quod, si incúlpato alan-tur nutrimento, inque puro versentur mari[?], carnis succique probitatem adipiscantur, adque saxatilium carnes proxime acce-dant.

Idem in methodo medendi boni succi & concoctu faciles tradit, minimeque glutino-sos:& alioin[?] loco, molli esse carne, nec minus laudandos quam saxatiles, atque ex iure albo febricitantibus esse adponendos. In libello de boni maliq;[?] succi cibis, molles qui-dem esse carnis asellos asserit, sed non æquè ac saxatilium friabilem. Iecur in popinali-bus delitiis haberi reperio. Eduntur autem aselli, inprimis vero truncus cum suis specie-bus, ex butyro bono & synapi, adiectis pipe-re,cinnamomo vel zinzibere: quin & frixus ex synapi cum pipere: vel ex arantii succo. Sale condiuntur & asseruatur aselli in Anglia, Scotia,Dania, Noruegia, indeque in alias re-giones deportantur. Sic autem sale condi-ti pessimi esse nutrimenti vel inde constat, quod septentrionis & maritimæ gentes fre-quentiori vberiorique asellorum salitorum Causa scorbuti[?]esu pessimo conducto in corporibus inqui-linoscorbuto, consistentur, huiusque ma-li causam crebriori salitorum esui assignatam reperio.
De harengis sale conditis idem esto iudicii.

page.notes: Page number read as 320; the first digit is doubtful. The left margin note reads "Caufa / scorbuti" (Causa scorbuti); the long s is printed like f, and the word "scorbuti" is doubtful. Several words are uncertain because of the long s and the worn print: "alioin", "maliq;", "asseruatur", "pessimi", "linoscorbuto", "consistentur", "iudicii" and "mari". The catchword "Mcslo." is doubtful. The printed text is not otherwise damaged, except at the edges of the scan.
